quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson compare playing styles to World Cup players
quotes.excerpt: I'll stick with Argentina. I will say Enzo Fernandez. He is Chelsea lad, he is fiery, competitive.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: For me, I will stick with Argentina. I will say Enzo Fernandez. He is Chelsea lad, he is fiery, competitive, and has made some big plays, but more so plays to other guys and get other guys in attacking positions to be successful.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: I will say you could be like Jude Bellingham. Every time England needed him, he showed up.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson discuss Ausar Thompson's defensive potential
quotes.excerpt: Ausar is a generational defender, but would Ausar be a generational defender at your height?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: The only reason why is Ausar is a generational defender, but would Ausar be a generational defender at your height? Obviously there is no shot.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: I'm saying like, he's going to be a player, he's able to be 6'4" in a good day.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart explains the importance of pre-game meals for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: All of us, all NBA players have a pre-game meal. That is my fuel for the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: All of us, all NBA players have a pre-game meal. It is either from my nutritionist or it is white rice, a vegetable and like either a white fish or grilled chicken. And that is my fuel for the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: He needs to eat, he needs to eat. He is going to be cramping.
